T: Don't look up. Look at the snacks.
D: Two siblings on a horse ranch try to film the thing hiding in the clouds above their valley.
P: Serve the snacks when the crowd sits down at the western theme park show.
S: Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked paprika and chipotle

Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked paprika and a pinch of chipotle, served in striped paper bags like a park stand. Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, then stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, a pinch of chipotle powder and fine salt. Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.
the Haywood horse ranch in the valley

Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 4mm strips. Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Toss the beef through and marinate overnight. Pat dry and lay on racks over trays. Dry at 75C with the oven door propped open a crack for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but still bendy.
Pinto beans with bacon, chipotle, molasses and tomato paste, cooked in cast iron
Pinto beans simmered with bacon, onion, chilli and molasses in a cast-iron pot until thick and smoky.
M: Haywood Ranch grilled tri-tip and beans
Rump cap grilled over coals and sliced, with warm pinto beans

Tri-tip or rump cap rubbed with salt, pepper and garlic, grilled over coals, rested and sliced, with pinto beans and fresh salsa. Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.
Angel's night shift chicken tinga burritos
Angel from Fry's wires the cameras for the long watch on the clouds

Chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle tomato sauce, rolled in flour tortillas with rice, black beans, cheese and lettuce. Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the chipotle, tomatoes and chicken and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice. Shred the chicken into the sauce and cook until thick. Warm the beans and tortillas. Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, chicken, cheese and lettuce and roll up tight.
W: Two soft chocolate cookies sandwiching a dome of marshmallow filling, rolled at the edges in silver sprinkles. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then 180g flour. Bake 16 small rounds at 175C for 9 minutes. Sandwich pairs with a marshmallow each, warm 1 minute to melt, then roll the edges in silver sprinkles.
K: Fresh watermelon and lime blended and strained, served over ice with mint
Blended watermelon and lime, strained and served over ice, sweet and very cold. Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar.
